headline.en: Make MCP behavior visible before integration
headline.zh: 接入前，看清 MCP 服务的行为

sub.en: mcp-conform launches a stdio MCP server, checks its handshake and tools through the MCP SDK, then produces a behavior/auth matrix. Unsupported client adapters remain marked n/a.
sub.zh: mcp-conform 启动 stdio MCP 服务，通过 MCP SDK 检查握手和工具，再生成行为与认证矩阵。未实现的客户端适配器保持 n/a。

body.en: The harness starts the target once over stdio and checks the live connection.
body.zh: 测试器通过 stdio 启动目标进程，并检查实际连接。

body.en: The matrix distinguishes pass, fail, skip and n/a.
body.zh: 矩阵区分 pass、fail、skip 和 n/a。

title.zh: 在 CI 中使用结果

body.en: JSON reports and SVG badges share the same collected check results.
body.zh: JSON 报告和 SVG 徽章来自同一组检查结果。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: The complete command starts the included echo fixture and sends actual MCP messages locally. No model calls or external client applications are involved.
note.zh: 完整命令启动随仓 echo 服务，在本地收发实际 MCP 消息，不调用模型或外部客户端应用。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Live local stdio MCP echo fixture. SDK protocol checks; no actual Claude Code, Cursor or Gemini application and no OAuth endpoint.

body.en: The complete command starts the included echo fixture and sends actual MCP messages locally. No model calls or external client applications are involved.
body.zh: 完整命令启动随仓 echo 服务，在本地收发实际 MCP 消息，不调用模型或外部客户端应用。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/mcp-conform.git
cd mcp-conform
npm ci
npm run build

limitations.en: Only one adapter runs SDK checks. Cursor and Gemini are placeholders; none of the three named client applications is launched.
limitations.zh: 只有一个适配器执行 SDK 检查。Cursor 和 Gemini 是占位实现，三个名称对应的客户端应用都不会被启动。

limitations.en: Running an arbitrary server also runs its code, and tools.call can have effects. Use a controlled server and fixture data.
limitations.zh: 启动任意服务会运行其代码，tools.call 也可能产生作用。应使用可控服务和样本数据。

limitations.en: The offline example does not exercise OAuth discovery or end-to-end authorization.
limitations.zh: 本地示例未运行 OAuth 发现或端到端授权。

body.en: A server can expose a valid-looking tool list yet fail at initialization or invocation. Running a repeatable protocol scenario makes these failures visible before you add the server to an agent configuration.
body.zh: 服务可能展示看似有效的工具列表，却在初始化或调用时失败。可重复的协议场景能在加入 Agent 配置前暴露这些问题。

body.en: runner.ts spawns the server with StdioClientTransport and initializes an MCP Client. The implemented adapter named claude-code runs handshake, tool-schema and tool-call checks. OAuth discovery is a separate HTTP probe when baseUrl is supplied. Cursor and Gemini adapters emit n/a rows without executing those applications.
body.zh: runner.ts 使用 StdioClientTransport 启动服务并初始化 MCP Client。名为 claude-code 的已实现适配器运行握手、工具 Schema 和调用检查。提供 baseUrl 后，OAuth 发现通过独立 HTTP 探测完成。Cursor 与 Gemini 适配器只输出 n/a 行，不会执行这些应用。

title.en: One SDK connection feeds the report
title.zh: 一次 SDK 连接生成检查报告

body.en: runner.ts spawns the server with StdioClientTransport and initializes an MCP Client. The implemented adapter named claude-code runs handshake, tool-schema and tool-call checks. OAuth discovery is a separate HTTP probe when baseUrl is supplied. Cursor and Gemini adapters emit n/a rows without executing those applications.
body.zh: runner.ts 使用 StdioClientTransport 启动服务并初始化 MCP Client。名为 claude-code 的已实现适配器运行握手、工具 Schema 和调用检查。提供 baseUrl 后，OAuth 发现通过独立 HTTP 探测完成。Cursor 与 Gemini 适配器只输出 n/a 行，不会执行这些应用。

alt.en: One SDK connection feeds the report
alt.zh: 一次 SDK 连接生成检查报告

body.en: The report describes this harness’s protocol checks. The claude-code row is an adapter label, not evidence that a Claude Code desktop or CLI application was launched. Authentication discovery checks metadata and challenge shape; it does not complete an OAuth token grant.
body.zh: 报告描述本测试器的协议检查。claude-code 行是适配器名称，并不证明启动过 Claude Code 桌面或 CLI 应用。认证发现只检查元数据和挑战格式，不完成 OAuth Token 授权。

body.en: Use --base-url only for an HTTP resource whose OAuth metadata you intend to probe. Without it, auth cells remain skip for stdio. The tool call uses echo when available; otherwise it derives minimal arguments from a candidate schema and can skip unsupported synthesized calls. Read the individual report rows rather than interpreting one green badge as universal compatibility.
body.zh: 仅在准备探测某个 HTTP 资源的 OAuth 元数据时使用 --base-url。省略后 stdio 的 auth 单元保持 skip。存在 echo 时优先调用，否则从候选工具 Schema 推导最小参数，无法支持的合成调用可能被跳过。应阅读各检查行，不能把绿色徽章理解为全面兼容。

body.en: Replace the fixture command with the command that starts a server you intend to test. --cwd selects its working directory; --timeout sets the handshake timeout in milliseconds (default 15000). --report and --badge can take output paths. Any fail returns exit 1; skip and n/a do not fail CI.
body.zh: 将样本命令替换为准备测试的服务启动命令。--cwd 指定工作目录，--timeout 设置握手超时毫秒数，默认 15000。--report 和 --badge 可指定输出路径。任何 fail 都返回 1，skip 和 n/a 不使 CI 失败。

details.code:
node dist/cli.js run node dist/fixtures/echo-server/server.js --json
node dist/cli.js run node dist/fixtures/echo-server/server.js --badge --report
